name: Murloc Poachers
summary: Along Lake Everstill, Murloc Poachers are stripping Lakeshire's waters of fish. Dockmaster Baren needs you to thin their swelling ranks before the town loses its main food supply.

sections.title: A Threat to the Town's Pantry
sections.body: Dockmaster Baren needs you to protect the fish that feed Lakeshire. Lake Everstill supplies the mountain town and its market with fresh catches. Large tribes of murlocs now crowd the shallows and scour the waters for food. Left unchecked, they could wipe out the local fish and leave Lakeshire without its main food supply.

sections.title: Strange Inland Migration
sections.body: Murlocs usually scavenge along the coast, so their numbers high in the Redridge Mountains are hard to explain. Dockmaster Baren wonders why they have come so far from the open ocean. They may be fleeing predators at sea, losing territorial fights, or drawn by Lake Everstill's plentiful waters. Whatever brought them inland, their presence points to trouble elsewhere in the region.

faq.answer: Dockmaster Baren oversees the docks and fishing traffic along Lake Everstill's shore at Lakeshire. He handles supplies brought by water and hires you to defend the lake's resources from aquatic threats.

faq.q: Why are murlocs in Redridge Mountains?
aliases: why are murlocs in lake everstill
faq.answer: Murlocs usually live along coastal shores and marshes, so their presence at high-altitude Lake Everstill is unusual. Dockmaster Baren suspects the tribes came inland to escape something worse along the coasts.

faq.q: What threat do the murlocs pose to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Lakeshire relies on Lake Everstill for fish and commerce. The murloc tribes are overfishing its waters, threatening the town's main food supply and local trade.

faq.q: Why does Dockmaster Baren collect murloc fins?
faq.answer: Dockmaster Baren collects eight murloc fins as proof that you have culled the tribes along the shore and helped deter their advance.

faq.q: Are there other tasks involving Lake Everstill's murlocs?
faq.answer: Yes. Dockmaster Baren also offers Selling Fish, which asks you to bring him the lake's famous spotted sunfish, caught by line or taken from the murlocs.

faq.q: What reward does Dockmaster Baren give for clearing the poachers?
faq.answer: After you bring him eight fins, Dockmaster Baren gives you a well-crafted Dwarven Fishing Pole to encourage care for the lake's waters.

angles.text: Lakeshire is already hard pressed by blackrock orcs and gnolls, leaving the Alliance town with little defense to protect its vital food supply in Lake Everstill.
As a human, you know Redridge was once a tranquil vacation haven for the kingdom of Stormwind. Hostile murlocs now overrun its pristine mountain waters, a sign of how far order has deteriorated.
